visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders and Technical look. Flat solid colors, no full-screen gradients. Subtle grid patterns on background for a network topology feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp borders, border-white/10 for grids and panels.
visual_enhancers.corners: Minimal border radius, use 'rounded-sm' or square for a rigorous technical feel.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle glow on active states (e.g. drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]) to simulate LED indicators.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp rectangular. Primary button uses Blue with white text.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or 'Grid Borders' layout. No heavy shadows. Flat solid.
components_strategy.tables: Dense, compact spacing. Monospace font for IPs, MAC addresses, and Ports to ensure strict alignment.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Switch. Labeled clearly. Required fields indicated.
components_strategy.status_indicators: Pulsing green dot (bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse) for active tunnels/rules. Solid red dot for inactive.

layouts.spacing: Generous external padding (p-6, p-8), compact internal density for data tables.
layouts.structure: Sidebar navigation (collapsible F-pattern) with main content split. Top summary KPI widgets.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid high density for dashboard widgets.

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out on interactive elements.
motion.loaders: Linear progress bars or monospace spinner (e.g. ASCII characters).

image_urls.description: Abstract pattern of dark squares on blue background
Rows of metal bars illuminated with blue light

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on dark backgrounds. Use text-white for primary, text-zinc-400 for secondary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark theme is the default and only theme. No light theme toggle needed unless requested.
Update index.css to map tailwind variables (like --primary) to the blue theme.
Update tailwind.config.js to include 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono' fonts.
Set the UI to run on port 5005 as requested by the user. Modify vite.config.js to set server port to 5005.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide React for network/admin symbols (Server, Activity, Shield, Network).
Build Shadcn Data Table with sorting/filtering for port forwarding rules.
For the IP and Ports columns in the table, ALWAYS use the JetBrains Mono monospace font.
No purple gradients. Stick to dark backgrounds with blue accents.
Create a clean Dashboard showing: Active Rules KPI, Connections KPI, and the Rules Table with a Toggle Switch for each rule.
Implement Sonner for toast messages on rule update success/failure.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js and .jsx files, not .tsx files. Share the guideline and implement components in JS.
Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the specified fonts and styling to create a distinct 'tech/terminal' feel.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Do not use `text-align: center` on the main app container.
No AI emojis for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Add micro-animations for hover states on table rows and buttons.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, using 1px borders instead of heavy drop shadows.
Prioritize Shadcn components. Export correctly (named for components, default for pages).
Never use transparent backgrounds without a blur or scrim in header/overlays where content is underneath.
